strings.%s, 손을 빌리고 싶은데 가능할까?: %s, could you lend me a hand?
strings.별건 아니고 드룰리지에 있는 벨리타 기억해?: Nothing much. Do you remember Velita in Drulridge?
Of course. The girl holding lion cubs.
strings.다행…이라고 하면 다행인데, 무슨 일이죠?: Glad... Sure, but what's the matter?
Velita's looking for toys for the cubs, but can't find anything suitable.
strings.성장기 사자라 웬만한 장난감은 바로 엉망진창이 돼서 조금 내구가 높은 걸: They're growing lions. Ordinary toys get destroyed immediately, so she wants something tougher.
strings.우리 용병단이 강아지나 고양이 장난감 같은 건 금방 금방 만들어 낼 수: Our company can make dog and cat toys in no time, but toys for lions are a bit much.
Sometimes we sew eyes onto dolls as well.
strings.가서 가져올게요. 잠깐, 하나로는 끝나지 않을 것 같은데 몇 개나 가져올: I'll fetch it. Wait, one probably won't be enough. How many should I bring?
strings.넉넉하게 다섯 개면 될 것 같아. 구하면 바로 드룰리지로 가, 알았지?: Five should be plenty. Take them straight to Drulridge, all right? And collect the fee from Velita.
It's been a while. You must have been busy.
Yes, a few things came up. I brought the lion cub toys you requested from the mercenaries.
Thank you. I've never seen toys this sturdy.
strings.잘 보니 누군가 아끼는 대상에게 선물해준 것 같은데…. 이렇게 귀한 걸: Looking closely, they seem like gifts someone gave to a loved one... May I really accept something so precious?
It's fine. 'He' has plenty of them.
Never mind. Anyway, see you next time.
strings.파르밀라가 의뢰비를 받으라 했지만, 그래도 어렵게 구할 수 있는 물건이: Parmila told me to, but they weren't difficult to obtain. I don't really want payment.
It's all right. I'll be going.
strings.당분간 이스트랜드의 루맨 근처에서 일을 봐야 할 것 같아서 루맨으로 가요: Lumen. I expect to be working around there in Eastland for a while.
strings.혹시 가시는 길에 로즈마리 님이나 프로즌 님을 보시면 안부 전해주시겠어요: If you see Rosemary or Frozen on the way, could you give them my regards?
strings.정확히 어디 계신지는 모르겠지만, 동방 대륙에 있다는 이야기를 들었거든요: I don't know exactly where they are, but I heard they're on the Eastern Continent.
strings.예전에 데미갓 프로즌 님께서 로즈마리 님과 함께 마을에 잠시 머무신 적이: The Demigod Frozen once stayed briefly in our village with Rosemary.
strings.마을에 잠깐 어려운 일이 있긴 했지만, 두 분 덕에 아무 일 없이 넘어갈: We had a little trouble then, but thanks to them, it passed without incident.
strings.리베라의 악덕 시장 제칼이 취임 전에 버섯의 숲을 엉망으로 만든 적이 있: Before taking office, Libera's corrupt mayor Zekal made a mess of Mushroom Forest. He said the mushrooms were profitable and stripped the place of mushrooms and fruit.
strings.예부터 미르간디아 지방의 자연과 자원엔 특별한 힘이 있어요. 버섯도 그런: Mirgandia's nature and resources have held special power since ancient times. The mushrooms have that power, too.
When he harvested so many, parts of the forest began to die.
So Frozen helped restore the forest's strength.
strings.네, 맞아요. 예전처럼 완벽하진 않지만, 그래도 지금의 모습을 유지할 수: Yes. It isn't as perfect as before, but it can maintain its present state.
strings.이야기 잘 들었어요. 그러면 로즈마리 님께는 안부를 전해드릴게요. 아직: Thank you for telling me. I'll give Rosemary your regards. She's still in Jude.
But I don't know where Frozen is.
That's a shame, but it can't be helped.
I'll ask around, just in case. Take care.
strings.감사드려요. 나중에 또 드룰리지에 오세요. 아셨죠?: Thank you. Visit Drulridge again, all right?
Well, if it isn't the hero of Jude.
Ugh, please don't call me that.
Why? You did save the kingdom.
strings.그런데 이곳엔 무슨 일이야? 안 그래도 이리스 님을 만나서 바쁘게 움직이: What brings you here? I heard you've met Lady Iris and been keeping busy.
strings.(그동안 있었던 일부터 이곳까지 오게 된 경위를 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain recent events and what brought you here.)
strings.벨리타, 그 예쁜 아이가 날 기억해주는군. 기분 좋은데! 언제 또 볼 수: Velita, that lovely girl, remembers me. That's nice! I wonder when I'll see her again.
strings.혹시 프로즌 님 소식은 알고 계신가요?: Have you heard anything from Frozen?
Oh, that man? It's been quite a while since he went to the Northern Sea. Probably...
strings.저번에도 북해라고만 들었는데, 정확히 어디인가요?: I heard Northern Sea last time, too. Where exactly?
strings.나도 잘 몰라. 이 동방 대륙의 제일 북쪽 얼음이 가득한 바닷가 근처로만: I'm not sure. All I know is an icy coast at the far north of this continent. Probably near Debora.
strings.벨리타가 그 인간 마음 써주는 건 알겠는데, 그 인간은 보통 인간이 아니: It's kind of Velita to think of him, but he's no ordinary human. He'll manage fine alone.
No news is good news. Wait... Something feels odd.
strings.로즈마리 님, 계십니까? 루맨에 갔다가 로즈마리 님 편지가 있어서 가져왔: Rosemary, are you here? I visited Lumen and found a letter for you, so I brought it.
Thanks. But who would write to...
strings.누구 편진데, 왜 그렇게 보세요?: Who is it from? Why that look?
strings.그 인간이야. 타이밍 참 기가 막히네. 뭐랄까, 그 인간이 쥬드 왕국의: That man. Incredible timing. Seems he has something to say to Jude's hero.
Engineering this sort of timing is one of his abilities...
strings.보니까 그 인간이 너한테 부탁이 있군. 이리스 어쩌고 네 이름 %s 어쩌: Looks like he has a favor for you. It mentions Iris and your name, %s, so like it or not, you'll have to hear it.
strings.어라? 이거 뒷 부분에 장치가 되어 있군. 특정 물건을 가져와야 해독이: Huh? The last part has a mechanism on it. We'll need a particular item to decipher it.
Sigh. We'll have to play along.
strings.이리스에 관한 거라면 어쩔 수 없죠. 그러면 제가 해야 하는 일이 뭔가요: If it's about Iris, I have no choice. What do I need to do?
strings.[마계의 파편]이란 물건을 두 개 가져와. 이름만 들어도 불길하군. 같이: Bring two [Fragments of the Demon Realm]. The name alone sounds ominous. I'd come with you, but he says only you can obtain them...
strings.그나저나 프로즌은 무슨 생각이기에 편지 봉인을 마계의 물건 같은 거로 한: What is Frozen thinking, sealing a letter with something from the Demon Realm?
They should be back about now...
I'm back. I brought the items.
strings.이게 그 물건…, 보기만 해도 섬찟하군. 마계의 기운을 품고 있는 물건은: So these are them... Chilling just to look at. It's been a while since I handled something with Demon Realm energy...
strings.넌 내가 싸우기만 한다고 생각하는 것 같은데, 이래 보여도 나는 세레스: You seem to think all I do is fight, but I came from the Temple of Seres.
Just joking. Anyway, this much is easy. Wait while I decipher it.
strings.(로즈마리가 편지 위에 파편을 놓자 이내 녹아 사라진다. 편지 주위로 알: (Rosemary places the fragments on the letter. They dissolve, and an unknown light swirls around the paper, revealing previously invisible writing.)
strings.알았어. 어디보자. 「로즈마리, 그리고 %s…. 이 편지를 읽고 있다면: All right. Let's see. 'Rosemary, and %s... If you're reading this letter, the two of you must be together.'
strings.「나는 지금 북해와 데보라 지역을 지나 데이모스 암흑 성국의 아발론을 향: 'I'm passing the Northern Sea and Debora, heading toward Avalon in the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos.'
strings.잠깐…. 이 인간…, 어디에 있다고?: Wait... That man... Where did he say he was?
strings.「분명 로즈마리는 나를 향해 이 인간 미친거 아냐? 이런 식으로 반응할: 'Rosemary is probably reacting with, "Has that man gone mad?"'
strings.당연하잖아. 미친 거 아냐? 지금 거기가 어디라고 혼자?: Of course I am! Has he gone mad? Going there alone?!
Wait. Let me calm down. Whew... Continuing.
strings.「내가 궁금한 게 있어서 그래. 금방 들어갔다 나올 테니 너무 걱정하지: 'There's something I'm curious about. I'll go in and out quickly, so don't worry. There are things I must do for this continent and Goddess Iris.'
Frozen always does as he pleases...
strings.「%s, 당신이 초인들을 만나고 있다는 이야기는 들었어. 그렇게 하다보면: '%s, I hear you've been meeting the Champions. Continue, and you may lessen the danger from that world approaching ours.'
He seems to know what you've been doing, too.
He's a great Demigod. Perhaps it's only natural he knows.
strings.「미안하군. 벨로쉬가 해결했다고 생각했던 일인데, 갑자기 틀어져 버려서…: 'I'm sorry. I thought Belosh had resolved this, but things suddenly went wrong... Something happened to him. I regret that I can't explain at length.'
strings.「신의 권능을 일부 하사받은 데미갓이라 하더라도 할 수 있는 일과 하지: 'Even a Demigod granted a portion of divine authority has things they can and cannot do... At the time, his arrogance kept him from distinguishing them.'
strings.벨로쉬, 프로즌, 리디아…. 세레스 신전 출신의 데미갓 분들인가요?: Belosh, Frozen, Lydia... Demigods from the Temple of Seres?
strings.세 분 다 본명이 아니야. 다들 저렇게 부르고 있어서 나도 그렇게 부르는: None of those are their real names. Everyone calls them that, so I do, too.
strings.「조만간 자리를 마련하지…. 여신님도 한번 뵙고 싶군. 그리고 사랑하는: 'I'll arrange a meeting soon... I'd like to see the goddess as well. And to my beloved Rosemary: don't worry about me. Don't react so violently to that, either.'
strings.(그 말과 함께 로즈마리 손에서 프로즌의 편지가 갈기갈기 찢긴다.): (With those words, Rosemary tears Frozen's letter to shreds.)
I'll head to Lumen now. Thank you for reading the letter, Rosemary.
strings.그러면 프리스트 미야 님께 편지 내용을 전해줬으면 해. 미야 님이 데미갓: Then tell Priest Miya what it said. She records some of the Demigods' activities.
strings.(흐음. 잘은 모르겠지만, 확실한 건 데이모스 교단 쪽에서 무슨 일을 꾸: (Hmm. Whatever else, the Deimos cult is plotting something... Could it be?! No, surely not?)
strings.(게다가 요즘 성역도 조용하고. 무식한 세이버들이 알아서 하겠지만….): (And the sanctuary has been quiet lately. Those muscleheaded Saviors will handle it, though...)
May our god always be with you... Ah, adventurer.
strings.(프리스트 미야에게 데미갓 프로즌의 편지가 왔다고 전한다.): (You tell Priest Miya about the letter from the Demigod Frozen.)
I see. You needn't worry too much.
Even if something serious happens, it's Frozen. He'll resolve it and return quickly.
Please take care as you continue your work, too.
strings.저희 교단에서 모험가님께 도움이 되는 칭호를 드리려고 합니다. 괜찮으신가: Our order wishes to grant you a helpful title. Would that be acceptable?
Melvic in Tartaros proposed it, and it was approved.
What? Melvic? If he proposed it...
strings.모험가님께 잘 어울리는 칭호라 생각돼요. 그럼 모험가님께 신의 축복이 함: I think it suits you well. May our god's blessing be with you.
strings.여신의 망나니 %s, 이상하잖아요!! 대체 교단에서는 나를 어떻게 생각하: '%s, the Goddess's Executioner'?! That's ridiculous! What does the order think of me?!
